title: "Not in this version"

This page is not in this version.

```{=html}
<script>
var path = location.pathname;
var version = path.match(/(\/v[^/]+)\//);
if (version) location.replace(path.slice(0, version.index) + version[1] + "/");
else location.replace(path.indexOf("/askr/") === 0 ? "/askr/" : "/");
</script>
```
